item.title: Two medical associations update their recommendations on gender-affirming care for trans youth
item.description: The American Medical Association, which has long supported gender-affirming care for transgender youth, has now endorsed some restrictions.The AMA recommended Wednesday that any gender-affirming surgeries be delayed until adulthood, The New York Times reports. While genital surgery is almost never performed on minors, some teens undergo top surgery or facial modifications. Gender-affirming care for youth more commonly includes puberty blockers, hormone therapy, social transition, and counseling.
